name: Steigenberger Wiltcher's
positioning: City hotel at 71 Avenue Louise in Brussels with a spa and wellness centre, a pool, a library and suites up to a Royal Suite with an open fireplace; officially named Steigenberger Icon Wiltcher's
best_for: Travelers who want a base on Avenue Louise in Brussels
Guests who want a spacious suite, such as a two-floor duplex suite
Travelers who want a city hotel with a spa and a pool

facts.text: The hotel is on Avenue Louise in Brussels.
The hotel's address is 71 Avenue Louise.
The Royal Suite bathroom has a whirlpool and a steam shower.
Junior Suites have a separate living area for working.
Deluxe rooms are furnished with fine wood furniture and have a Nespresso coffee machine.
Superior room bathrooms have both a bathtub and a shower.
The fitness gym has modern cardio equipment.
Loui Cocktail Bar & Restaurant serves regional and international cuisine.
Breakfast is served in the café.

highlights.text: The Royal Suite has a living room with an open fireplace.
Duplex suites have separate living and sleeping areas over two floors, with entrances on both floors.
The hotel's library is popular with locals as well as hotel guests.
The hotel has a spa and wellness centre.
The hotel has a swimming pool.

considerations.text: The nearest parking is a public car park, which charges a fee.
Pets are allowed on request, for a fee.
WhataHotel notes a traditional formal atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
